movingBand.observation: The upper-right and top-center groups at2500 clear, opening a broad upper-middle gap by3000. Middle-right bodies broaden into a horizontal branching cluster; the lower-right grouping changes shape and reaches the bottom edge. This matches the earlier moving trajectory but is judged under this new within-arm screen.

stationaryBand.observation: The tall upper-middle cluster at2500 clears by3000, leaving a broad empty upper-middle region. New branching groups occupy the middle-left and lower-middle-left. The bottom-left group expands into a wider, denser arrangement along the bottom edge. These are occupied-location and gap changes, not only colors.

Moving bodies concentrate in several right-half groups; stationary has small upper-left and upper-middle groups with a broad middle gap and dense bottom-left occupancy.
